business.what_it_does: Company manufactures and sells food products, milk products, nutrition, prepared dishes, cooking aids, powdered and liquid beverages, and confectionery items.

segments.name: Milk Products and Nutrition
segments.what: Sells dairy whitener, condensed milk, UHT milk, yogurt, and baby foods.

segments.name: Prepared Dishes and Cooking Aids
segments.what: Sells noodles, sauces, seasonings, pasta, cereals, and pet food.

segments.name: Powdered and Liquid Beverages
segments.what: Sells instant coffee, instant tea, and ready to drink beverages.

segments.name: Confectionery
segments.what: Sells bar countlines, tablets, and sugar confectionery.

business.mix_note: No single customer accounts for more than 10% of the Company's revenue.

credibility.line: Management frequently revises capex plans and targets, though core margins and cash generation remain strong.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: EBIT% of 20.7% in Sep 2026 supports management's claim of maintaining stable operating margins.
Strong operating cash flow of 5048.0 crore in Mar 2026 confirms robust cash generation.
Initial 2023-2024 capex guidance of 33 billion INR was subsequently replaced by a broader INR 5000-5800 crore multi-year target.

bull: High profitability with ROCE at 85.3% and ROE at 74.2% anchored in financial statements.
Practically debt-free balance sheet with a low D/E ratio of 0.08 in Sep 2026.
Strong cash conversion with 5y cash conversion at 1.25 and Mar 2026 FCF at 4221.0 crore.
bear: Net profit volatility with Sep 2025 PAT declining by -17.4% YoY.
Borrowings increased to 464.0 crore by Sep 2026 from 345.0 crore in Mar 2024.
Frequent shifting of capital expenditure targets across consecutive calls reduces guidance reliability.
watch: Verify outlet expansion progress toward the 6 million target.
Monitor sustainability of double-digit revenue growth rates averaging around 20%.
